_why_two_claims: AGREEMENT asks whether the engines compute the same thing; RECOVERY asks whether they compute the right thing. Neither implies the other.

truth.source: the fixture's data-generating process: log-normal groups with medians exp(1.0), exp(1.3), exp(1.6)

agreement.claim: both engines report the same H statistic, p-value and group medians
agreement._note: Observed spread on the committed fixture: 0 at ten significant digits on every key. harness/comparisons_examples.test.py checks H against the textbook no-ties formula computed from ranks.

recovery.claim: each group median is close to the median the fixture was built with

calibration.rule: about 1.3 times the measured 99th percentile miss, rounded up
calibration.limits: The test itself has no parameter to recover; recovery is on the group medians reported beside it. Measured by harness/comparisons_examples.test.py over seeds 0 to 99.
